reference: util-linux uuidgen, run by the harness with Bash as the reference shell and LC_ALL=C; only option errors are compared (status recorded on stdout, stderr bytes), since UUIDs differ between runs.
coverage: Pass 8 (G120): option errors in GNU form, naming the command only, with the GNU status.

cases.purpose: G120: an unknown long option is reported as uuidgen reports it, with no internal builtin name and the GNU status.
G120: an unknown short option is reported as uuidgen reports it, with no internal builtin name and the GNU status.
